description: This file defines a Java interface for reading pocket account mappings within the Fineract self-service pocket module. It declares methods to retrieve all mappings and validate specific pocket-account associations.

classes.name: PocketAccountMappingReadPlatformService
classes.description: Interface for retrieving and validating pocket account mappings.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Retrieves all pocket account mapping data.

methods.name: validatePocketAndAccountMapping
methods.description: Validates if a pocket and account mapping exists for given IDs and account type.
